identity.lightPolicy: light_reach_v4|winding-normal front|two-sided not modelled|opaque only|lit = drawn lighting-shader shapes; editor markers not drawn|radius = base + XRDS|shape count by placed box|emitters v1: emissive (Own_Emit, value > 0), self-lit effect (no Effect_Lighting), particle emitter extent
